item.title: TT-102: RFC 4180 CSV export
item.brief:
Implement TT-102 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- tasktracker.export.to_csv(tasks) emits header id,title,tags,status,due and one row per task in input order.
- Tags are joined with semicolons; due is ISO YYYY-MM-DD or empty.
- A field containing comma, double quote, CR or LF is enclosed in double quotes; embedded double quotes are doubled; fields without those characters are not quoted.
- Every line, including header and final line, ends in CRLF.
- Add focused tests in a new, ticket-specific test module (for example tests/test_tt102_csv.py), avoiding shared test files.
- Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep the full suite passing.
- Use only the Python standard library.
- Commit this ticket's changes as one separate commit.

item.title: TT-101: Reject impossible due dates
item.brief:
Implement TT-101 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- In tasktracker.dates, define InvalidDate as a ValueError subclass.
- parse_due(text, today): impossible calendar dates (including 2026-02-30, 2025-02-29, 2026-04-31, 2026-13-01, 2026-00-10) raise InvalidDate whose message contains the original input text.
- Anything not matching a supported form raises InvalidDate, not bare ValueError.
- Relative offsets accept +Nd only: N days after today; +0d is today. Reject negative and unsigned offsets.
- today/tomorrow continue to work; matching is case-insensitive and ignores surrounding whitespace.
- Add focused tests in a new, ticket-specific test module (for example tests/test_tt101_dates.py), avoiding shared test files.
- Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep the full suite passing.
- Use only the Python standard library.
- Commit this ticket's changes as one separate commit.

item.title: TT-103: Search query syntax
item.brief:
Implement TT-103 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- Define QueryError in tasktracker.search.
- Split query into whitespace-separated terms except within double quotes; a quoted phrase is one term; all terms must match (AND).
- Bare words and phrases match title substrings case-insensitively.
- tag:NAME matches exact tag case-insensitively.
- status:open and status:done match status.
- Unknown fields, unknown statuses, and unterminated quotes raise QueryError.
- Empty/blank query matches all tasks; preserve input order.
- Add focused tests in a new, ticket-specific test module (for example tests/test_tt103_search.py), avoiding shared test files.
- Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep the full suite passing.
- Use only the Python standard library.
- Commit this ticket's changes as one separate commit.

item.title: TT-104: Undo TaskStore operations
item.brief:
Implement TT-104 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add TaskStore.undo() to revert most recent not-yet-undone add, complete, or delete; successive calls walk backward in LIFO order across all operation types.
- Undo add removes that task; undo complete reopens it; undo delete restores it exactly under the same id.
- Never reuse ids, including ids belonging to undone adds.
- Define NothingToUndo in tasktracker.store; raise it when no recorded operation remains to undo.
- Failed operations (for example complete of unknown id) are not recorded.
- Add focused tests in a new, ticket-specific test module (for example tests/test_tt104_undo.py), avoiding shared test files.
- Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep the full suite passing.
- Use only the Python standard library.
- Commit this ticket's changes as one separate commit.
